Primary death toll | Turkish drone shells residential area in Al-Qamishly killing four including two children

Al-Hasakah province: SOHR activists have documented the death of four people including two young brothers and two unidentified people believed to belong to “Cadres” as a primary death toll, where a Turkish drone shelled Al-Sina’a area in Al-Qamishly.

A few hours ago, SOHR activists documented the death of two brothers as a primary death toll, due to the explosion that took place in Al-Sina’a area in Al-Qamishly city, coinciding with the flight of Turkish drone over the region.

According to residents in the explosion site, the explosion was caused by a Turkish drone, where the sound of a missile was heard moments before the explosion and targeted a van of a “Kadir” member, killing two children and injuring others.

SOHR activists reported hearing loud explosion in Al-Qamishly city, due to the explosion of a car in Al-Sina’a Al-Qadima (old industrial) area at Kaziyah Hasko, killing one person and injuring at least three others.
